sentences.en: The salvation of the human race starts with the family.
sentences.zh: 人类种族的拯救始于家庭。

sentences.en: I gave some of my old clothes to the Salvation Army.
sentences.zh: 我把一些旧衣服捐给了救世军。

sentences.en: It isn't possible to determine if there's either salvation or damnation.
sentences.zh: 无法确定是否有得救或下地狱的可能性。

senses.zh: 拯救，救助,救星，救世主,解救办法，救济措施,救济品
